_about: Settings of max_corona_materials. Put your own values in config/project.json (same layout, only the keys you change); --set KEY=VALUE changes one for a run.

paths._reference: the 3ds Max scene whose Corona materials are the templates; null = the one .max file in input\
paths._model: the model to convert, an FBX (or an already imported .max); null = the one .fbx file in input\
paths._model_materials: the model's materials with their mesh counts and colours (JSON: [{name, meshes, rgb}]); null = input\model_materials.json if it is there, else read from the imported model
paths._output_dir: where the results go; null = output, in the folder the command is run from
paths._work_dir: cache of intermediate results (the raw import, the material library, the maps; safe to delete); null = %LOCALAPPDATA%/ing_studio_toolkit/max_corona_materials

max._version: the 3ds Max that does the work (needs Corona): auto = the newest installed, or a year like 2025
max._model_root: the node the FBX import puts every equipment group under (SketchUp: Model); missing = the scene's top-level nodes are the groups

parts._about: the part materials: name -> [template material of the reference scene, diffuse [r, g, b] or null = the template's, glossiness or null, IOR or null]. Which model material becomes which part is decided by the rules in corona_materials/parts.py

sandstone._about: corona_materials.bat sandstone: scenes re-finished in Technogym's Sand Stone materials (corona_materials/sandstone.py)
sandstone._map_size: the texture maps' size in pixels (4096; 2048 for a quick try)
sandstone._images_dir: a folder whose images (logos, console screens) the scenes' logo and display materials use; copied next to the maps. null = none
sandstone._fallback: the Sand Stone material of a scene material the rules do not know
sandstone._parallel: how many scenes 3ds Max works on at once
sandstone._preview_parallel: how many scenes are rendered at once for the previews (a render of a whole scene takes many GB of memory)
sandstone._preview_passes: Corona passes of a preview render
sandstone._closeups: how many kinds of equipment of each scene are rendered close up
sandstone._smooth: smoother round parts: every mesh welded and smoothed by angle, and round objects (rollers, tubes, handles, discs) get a TurboSmooth that keeps the hard edges sharp
sandstone._smooth_angle: edges sharper than this (degrees) stay hard; gentler ones are smoothed
sandstone._smooth_iterations: TurboSmooth iterations in the viewport (each one: 4 x the faces of a round object); 0 = the model's own faces, smoothly shaded
sandstone._chamfer: rounded edges: the sharp edges of plain solid parts (plates, boxes, bars, pads) get a real rounded chamfer (a live Chamfer modifier), each one checked; the other edges are rounded in renders by Corona Round Edges
sandstone._chamfer_angle: edges sharper than this (degrees) are chamfered
sandstone._chamfer_ratio: the chamfer: this part of the object's smallest dimension (at most a quarter of its wall's thickness, and its material's chamfer_mm)
sandstone._chamfer_min_mm: a smaller chamfer (mm) would not show: left out

_fallback_part: the part of a mesh whose material is in no map
